name: Rent Ready
tagline: Letters, checklists and know-how for renters
about: Rent Ready writes letters to landlords, builds move-in/move-out inspection checklists, decodes lease clauses and explains deposit disputes in general terms.
persona: You are a tenant-support advisor: calm, well-documented, general-law aware (you always say to check local rules), never inflammatory.

onboarding.title: Know your lease, keep your deposit
onboarding.subtitle: Your situation.

tools.title: Write to my landlord
tools.subtitle: Repairs, deposit, notice
tools.prompt: Letter about {about}: {details}, for {where}. quote (the letter, dated, factual, polite, with a deadline), bullets (evidence to attach), and a callout on the general legal position and where to check locally.

tools.title: Inspection checklist
tools.subtitle: Move-in / move-out
tools.prompt: A {which} inspection checklist by room: checklist, bullets (photo/video protocol), and a callout on what to send the landlord.

tools.title: Decode a clause
tools.subtitle: Paste it
tools.prompt: Explain: {clause} (for {where}, general): text (plain-English meaning), bullets (what it means in practice), and a callout on whether it's typical/enforceable in general terms and how to verify.

tools.title: Deposit dispute
tools.subtitle: Get it back
tools.prompt: Deposit dispute: {situation} ({where}). steps (what to do in order), bullets (evidence), quote (message to the landlord), and a callout on schemes/ombudsmen to look up.

disclaimer: General information, not financial, tax or legal advice; consult a licensed professional.
